# Radoslav Radev Predicts That Injuries From Skipping Progressions Waste One Year Of Planche Training Time

Radoslav Radev predicts that injuries from skipping progressions cause months of recovery time, and that two injuries holding you back for, let's say, six months is one year of wasted planche training time. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 04:24]

## Details

- A lot of people stay stuck because they injured themselves and then have to wait a couple of months for recovery. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 04:24]
- That is why you are wasting two three years for the planche because you have two injuries that holding you back for let's say six months that's one year of wasted time. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 04:24]
- He promises that if you train like this, you will avoid injuries and you will progress faster. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 04:19]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 04:19 (Radoslav Radev): "And I promise you guys, if you train like this, you will avoid injuries and you will progress faster."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 04:24 (Radoslav Radev): "a lot of people staying stuck because they injured themselves and after that they have to wait couple of months for the recovery and that's why you're wasting two three years for the planche because you have two injuries that holding you back for let's say six months that's one year of wasted time"

## Connected Ideas

- [[Radoslav Radev Requires A Minimum 15 Pull-Ups, 20 Dips And 30 Push-Ups Before Planche, Front Lever And Handstand Skills]] — lacking the foundation is one cause of the injuries that waste time.
- [[Radoslav Radev Requires A Minimum 10-Second Hold Before Progressing To The Next Planche Or Front Lever Step]] — rushing progressions is another cause.
- [[Radoslav Radev Requires Increasing Body Temperature By One Degree As A Warm-Up Before Planche And Front Lever Training]] — cold joints are another cause.
